div.p: RateScout tracks 330 currencies and 55,285 exchange directions, powered by BestChange monitoring data. No sign-up, no fees — just clear, comparable rates.

div.h2: Built for people who compare before they exchange
div.p: Everything you need to find a better rate — nothing you don't.

article.p: Crypto and cash, majors and exotics — all in one searchable directory.
Every pairing you can think of, with the current going rate for each.
Rates refresh every hour, so you're never comparing stale numbers.
Built on the monitoring data trusted by exchangers for years.
No account, no paywall, no hidden commission on the rates you see.
Rates are indicative and for reference only — never a binding offer.

div.p: From search to decision in four steps.
Choose the currency you have and the one you want — from BTC to cash EUR.
We show the current rate for that direction, pulled from BestChange monitoring.
Scan across 55,285 directions to find where your pair sits best.
Head to your chosen exchanger. RateScout is a directory — we don't hold funds.
Next block reward cut, tracked live.
Search 330 currencies and 55,285 directions — free, no sign-up required.
